descriptions: A headframe of black timber over a shaft, with a ladder going down and a cold breath coming up.
features: A board of brass tallies, one per miner. Too many still hang on the 'down' side.
ambient: Something below taps three times, then stops.

descriptions: A level tunnel cut straight into the hill, rails rusting along its floor.
A low drift where you walk bent double, timbers creaking overhead.
features: An abandoned tub, half full of ore.

descriptions: A tall cavern hollowed out by miners following a seam upward into the dark.
A stope with ladders lashed up its walls, climbing out of the lamplight.
features: A seam of silver ore glinting in the wall, half worked.
ambient: Grit pats down from somewhere above.

descriptions: A flooded shaft bottom, the water black and perfectly still.
A sump with a broken pump, water creeping up the walls.
features: A miner's boot floating, upside down.

descriptions: A gallery cut along a seam of coal, black on black, shining where your light touches it.
features: Picks left leaning in a row, as if the shift will be back.

descriptions: A side-cave where miners left offerings for the knockers: crusts, candle-ends, a twist of tobacco.
features: Tiny footprints in the dust, going round and round the offerings.
